tables.name: user_role_assignment
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, user_id, role_id, branch_id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

tables.name: branch_working_hours
checks: start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND end_minute > start_minute
valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

tables.name: resource
checks: (kind = 'STAFF' AND branch_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'STAFF' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: branch_service_offering
checks: price_rial IS NULL OR (price_rial >= 0 AND price_rial % 10 = 0)
NOT active OR (price_rial IS NOT NULL AND duration_minutes IS NOT NULL AND buffer_before_minutes IS NOT NULL AND buffer_after_minutes IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: staff_branch_assignment
checks: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

tables.name: staff_service_eligibility
checks: NOT active OR verified_at IS NOT NULL

tables.name: staff_schedule_rule
checks: start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND end_minute > start_minute
valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

working_period.constraint: no_cross_branch_staff_shift: staff_id = and working_period &&, published/unarchived only

tables.name: customer
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, contact_lookup_hash) WHERE contact_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND contact_lookup_hash IS NOT NULL

tables.name: availability_configuration
checks: NOT enabled OR (slot_stride_minutes IS NOT NULL AND lead_minutes IS NOT NULL AND horizon_days IS NOT NULL AND hold_ttl_seconds IS NOT NULL AND quote_ttl_seconds IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: booking_policy_version
checks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from

(deposit_requirement = 'NONE' AND amount_kind IS NULL AND fixed_rial IS NULL AND basis_points IS NULL AND minimum_rial IS NULL AND maximum_rial IS NULL) OR (deposit_requirement <> 'NONE' AND ((amount_kind = 'FIXED' AND fixed_rial > 0 AND fixed_rial % 10 = 0 AND basis_points IS NULL) OR (amount_kind = 'PERCENTAGE' AND basis_points BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND fixed_rial IS NULL)))
minimum_rial IS NULL OR (minimum_rial >= 0 AND minimum_rial % 10 = 0)
maximum_rial IS NULL OR (maximum_rial >= 0 AND maximum_rial % 10 = 0)
minimum_rial IS NULL OR maximum_rial IS NULL OR minimum_rial <= maximum_rial
lifecycle = 'DRAFT' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

deposit_requirement='NONE' OR (amount_kind IS NOT NULL AND ((amount_kind='FIXED' AND fixed_rial IS NOT NULL AND basis_points IS NULL) OR (amount_kind='PERCENTAGE' AND basis_points IS NOT NULL AND fixed_rial IS NULL)))

tables.name: booking_policy_assignment
checks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from

(scope_kind = 'BUSINESS' AND num_nonnulls(branch_id,service_id,package_id,booking_id)=0) OR (scope_kind='BRANCH' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(service_id,package_id,booking_id)=0) OR (scope_kind='SERVICE' AND service_id IS NOT NULL AND package_id IS NULL AND booking_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='PACKAGE' AND package_id IS NOT NULL AND service_id IS NULL AND booking_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind IN ('BOOKING','ADMIN_OVERRIDE') AND booking_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(branch_id,service_id,package_id)=0)
scope_kind <> 'ADMIN_OVERRIDE' OR (override_reason IS NOT NULL AND authorized_by IS NOT NULL)

effective_period.constraint: no_equal_rank_policy_assignment: business_id =, scope_key =, priority =, effective_period &&, active routing only

tables.name: booking
checks: origin <> 'CUSTOMER' OR customer_id IS NOT NULL
status = 'DRAFT' OR active_revision_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: booking_hold
checks: (status='ACTIVE' AND released_at IS NULL) OR (status<>'ACTIVE' AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: resource_allocation
checks: (allocation_kind IN ('HOLD','BOOKING') AND revision_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_id IS NOT NULL AND time_off_id IS NULL AND closure_id IS NULL AND (allocation_kind <> 'HOLD' OR hold_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (allocation_kind='TIME_OFF' AND time_off_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(revision_id,hold_id,closure_id)=0) OR (allocation_kind='CLOSURE' AND closure_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(revision_id,hold_id,time_off_id)=0) OR (allocation_kind='MAINTENANCE' AND num_nonnulls(revision_id,hold_id,time_off_id,closure_id)=0)
(resource_kind='STAFF' AND resource_branch_id IS NULL) OR (resource_kind IN ('CHAIR','ROOM','DEVICE') AND resource_branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_id=resource_branch_id)
indexes: (business_id, resource_id, busy_starts_at) WHERE released_at IS NULL

busy_period.constraint: no_live_resource_overlap: resource_id = and busy_period &&, live allocations only

tables.name: booking_status_history
checks: (from_status IS NULL AND to_status='DRAFT') OR (from_status IS NOT NULL AND ((from_status='DRAFT' AND to_status='HELD') OR (from_status='DRAFT' AND to_status='CANCELLED') OR (from_status='DRAFT' AND to_status='EXPIRED') OR (from_status='HELD' AND to_status='PENDING_PAYMENT') OR (from_status='HELD' AND to_status='CONFIRMED') OR (from_status='HELD' AND to_status='CANCELLED') OR (from_status='HELD' AND to_status='EXPIRED') OR (from_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND to_status='CONFIRMED') OR (from_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND to_status='CANCELLED') OR (from_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND to_status='EXPIRED') OR (from_status='CONFIRMED' AND to_status='CHECKED_IN') OR (from_status='CONFIRMED' AND to_status='CANCELLED') OR (from_status='CONFIRMED' AND to_status='NO_SHOW') OR (from_status='CHECKED_IN' AND to_status='IN_SERVICE') OR (from_status='CHECKED_IN' AND to_status='CANCELLED') OR (from_status='IN_SERVICE' AND to_status='COMPLETED') OR (from_status='IN_SERVICE' AND to_status='CANCELLED')))

tables.name: idempotency_record
checks: state <> 'COMPLETE' OR (response_code IS NOT NULL AND response_snapshot IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: media_asset
checks: visibility <> 'PUBLISHED' OR (status='READY' AND validated_at IS NOT NULL AND recognizable_person IS NOT NULL AND consent_checked_at IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: media_publication_consent
checks: valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > granted_at
revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= granted_at

tables.name: portfolio_item
checks: status <> 'PUBLISHED' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

tables.name: portfolio_media
checks: (role IN ('BEFORE','AFTER') AND comparison_group IS NOT NULL) OR (role NOT IN ('BEFORE','AFTER') AND comparison_group IS NULL)
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, item_id, comparison_group, role) WHERE role IN ('BEFORE','AFTER')

tables.name: notification_channel_config
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, branch_id, channel) NULLS NOT DISTINCT

tables.name: notification_template
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, branch_id, code, channel, locale, version_number) NULLS NOT DISTINCT

tables.name: notification_preference
checks: NOT opted_in OR (consented_at IS NOT NULL AND consent_text_version IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL)

tables.name: notification_delivery_attempt
indexes: UNIQUE (business_id, provider_key, provider_message_ref) WHERE provider_message_ref IS NOT NULL
